summary: The four-call deterministic baseline matches the best eligible result in the seven-candidate reference set at the selected default conditions. Live Microsoft AI performance is unmeasured.

oracle.definition: Best eligible result in the finite declared candidate set only.

contract_tests.scope: Application contracts and real-engine integration; no live AI performance measurement.

limitations: Model snapshot comparisons, not measured field curtailment or Ireland-wide percentages.
Both search methods have the same maximum candidate-call budget; early stops are reported.
The oracle's extra calls are for evaluation only and are not part of either search budget.
Accepted wind is compared only under fixed available wind and load conditions.
Wall times include provider latency and may be affected by engine caching; no speed superiority claim.
The deterministic baseline can match exhaustive search when the budget covers the action set.
Passing authored provider tests does not establish AI reasoning quality or grounding accuracy.
The original Irish source profile remains blocked. The separate conditional Irish study inspects two verified stored alternatives; these are not approved operating actions.
